# bg_tarn_wide: bg_tarn's lake as a long walk along its shore, in the style of
# Cast n Chill -- a backlit sunset, every layer a silhouette lit along its top.
# Generated by tools/generate_bg_tarn_wide.py, which states the same rows; its
# header has the art argument. Model: src/render/depth_rig.h; format:
# src/render/backdrop_set.h.
#
# The rig is bg_tarn's on purpose (horizon 200, contact 264, strength 0.75), so
# the two scenes are the same lake seen the same way; bg_tarn/backdrop.txt has
# the reasons for each number.
#
# The world is 2752 cells wide. Layers whose factor keeps them from ever
# showing more than part of it are narrower tiles, stated with width=: a layer
# at factor f shows 345 + f * (2752 - 345) columns over the whole walk through a
# 3440-wide window, and backdrop_set_test holds each width to that.
#
#     sky, glint     0.00   needs  345   width 688
#     mountains      0.031  needs  421   width 688
#     ridge          0.063  needs  496   width 688
#     hills          0.109  needs  608   width 688
#     far shore      0.156  needs  721   width 1376  (and its reflection)
#     islets         0.375  needs 1248   width 1376
#     shore, near    0.63+  needs 1850+  the set's 2752
#
# The reflection is the far shore upside down, at the far shore's own factor
# and width so the two stay aligned, and on the plane's rows vertically so it
# stays on the water as the plane stretches under a rising camera -- the glint's
# arrangement, at a factor that is not zero.
#
# The foreground is 1.30 and 1376 wide. Faster than the world, it repeats at any
# width, so it is sparse grass and ferns that nobody can catch repeating.

size    2752 288
anchor  standing
rig     200 264 0.75
ripple  0.6

# file                             how it moves   flags
layer   bg_tarn_wide_13_sky.bmp         factor=0.00    width=688  opaque
layer   bg_tarn_wide_12_clouds.bmp      factor=0.01    width=688  drift=-0.6
layer   bg_tarn_wide_11_plane.bmp       plane          ripple=211:232
layer   bg_tarn_wide_10_reflection.bmp  factor=0.15625 width=1376 on_plane ripple=211:223
layer   bg_tarn_wide_09_glint.bmp       factor=0.00    width=688  on_plane ripple=212:231
layer   bg_tarn_wide_08_mountains.bmp   foot=202       width=688
layer   bg_tarn_wide_07_ridge.bmp       foot=204       width=688
layer   bg_tarn_wide_06_hills.bmp       foot=207       width=688
layer   bg_tarn_wide_05_far_shore.bmp   foot=210       width=1376
layer   bg_tarn_wide_04_islets.bmp      foot=224       width=1376
layer   bg_tarn_wide_03_shore.bmp       foot=240
layer   bg_tarn_wide_02_near.bmp        foot=252
layer   bg_tarn_wide_01_foreground.bmp  factor=1.30    width=1376 foreground
